In [`clinicbench/scorer.py`](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L399-L400), `process` builds the required read-back field set as `need = {"action", "slot", "doctor"} | ({"cost"} if w["component"]["action"] == "book" else set())` and checks `need <= {k for k, v in readback.items() if v is not None}`. Because `cancel` read-backs only state `action` and `appt` (no `slot` or `doctor`) and covered `book` read-backs have `cost=None` (only `self_pay` bookings state a cost), both are marked incomplete even when complete.

Updated `process` in [scorer.py](file:///work/clinicbench/scorer.py#L399-L405) so that the required read-back fields (`need`) depend on the write action and booking basis:

- `cancel`: requires `{"action", "appt"}` instead of `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}`.
- `book` with `basis == "self_pay"`: requires `{"action", "slot", "doctor", "cost"}`.
- `book` with `basis != "self_pay"` (e.g. `"covered"`) and `move`: requires `{"action", "slot", "doctor"}`.
